:::{#exm-exp-surv}

#### Survival probability of an exponential time

Suppose an event time $T$ is exponential with rate $\lambda = 0.1$ events per year.
By @thm-exp-surv,
the probability of surviving past 5 years is $\surv(5) = e^{-\lambda \cdot 5}$.
The code below computes this value from the formula and from R's exponential distribution function:

```{r}
#| label: exm-exp-surv-calc
exp_lambda <- 0.1
exp_t <- 5
surv_formula <- exp(-exp_lambda * exp_t)
surv_pexp <- pexp(exp_t, rate = exp_lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
```

The formula gives $\surv(5) =$ `r round(surv_formula, 4)`,
and `pexp()` gives `r round(surv_pexp, 4)`,
so the two agree.

:::
